decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and numbered P100, P101, P102, P103, P104, P01, P02, P03, P04, P05, P06, P07, P08, P09, P10, P11, P12, P13, P201, P202, P203, P204, P205, P206, P500, Heritage Statement, Design and Access Statement, Received 26 August 2011 and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building is occupied).
Condition : 3 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the walls of the extensions hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Demolition of existing single storey rear conservatory and roof top stair housing, erection of a single storey rear infill extension, part first and part second floor rear extensions, erection of a third floor roof extension and alterations to rear elevation and roof top openings.
